**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Alice](../persons.html#1025),
[I](../persons.html#1606) wrote instantly to thank [Dr.

Moberly](../persons.html#1015) for his good news, but the cart was missed on Sunday morning.

Tell us if [Margaret](../persons.html#83) has seen [the brother](../persons.html#1026)[^1], and what she said of him, and tell us who the boy is like and whether he is large or small, dark or fair.

Three days of well-doing make us think you will soon be ready for ‘[Heartsease](../books.html#19)’; there will be plenty for you to begin upon. I am bent upon Charlotte seeing all she can of [Bishop Selwyn](../persons.html#1295), and trust to Dr.

Moberly to manage it for her, and must have her see [Mrs.

Selwyn](../persons.html#1297) somehow.

[^1]: Selwyn William Moberly (1854-1871), seventh son and youngest of the Moberlys\' fifteen children, was christened on 8 June 1854.
